metadata.title: Grade 5 – MCQ distractor candidate lists (gapfill-first)
metadata.spec: distractor.md: strict POS matching, same semantic field, multi-unit pooling, avoid length/cognate giveaways
metadata.engines: V1 app.js (Greek Listening, English Definition) + V2 app_v2.js (greek/def/gapfill/fact). Live engines sample 1 target + 3 distractors at runtime from unit pool.

usage.gapfill_sentence: Use candidates_word (English words, POS-matched, same field). Pick 3 of 4-6. POS tag shown but not used for filtering in current engine – patch to filter by pos_group.
usage.greek_meaning_matcher: Needs 3 Greek translation distractors. candidates_gr_words lists the WORDS whose Greek translations to use (Greek strings not yet in 5th-grade JSON – resolve via future meaning_gr catalog or reuse 6th-grade catalog for overlaps). Do NOT use English words here.
usage.definition_matcher: Needs 3 English definition distractors. candidates_def_words lists the WORDS whose definitions to use (definitions not yet in 5th-grade JSON – resolve via future definition_en catalog). Do NOT use English words here.
